correctness.rationale: For n>=4 T_n has diameter 2; a selected geodesic triple is exactly an induced path of length two. Therefore T_n[S] must be a disjoint union of cliques. Identify chosen T_n vertices with selected edges of K_n: connected K_n-edge components pairwise incident iff each is a star or a triangle; isolated K_n vertices are allowed. This is a labeled combinatorial species with c_1=1, c_2=z, c_3=3z^2+z^3 and c_s=s z^(s-1) (s>=4), giving EGF exp(sum c_s u^s/s!) = exp(u e^(uz)-u^2 z/2+u^3 z^3/6). A component containing label 1 proves recurrence and top degree/triangle partition count. Independently enumerated all selected edge subsets in K_n for n=0..6 and checked all coefficient counts, with Ψ_6=1+15z+105z²+275z³+240z⁴+66z⁵+10z⁶. Formula rests on exhaustive component classification, not testing.
